comment: The training yard, a developer zone (docs/admin.md): only admins go in, from the Admin menu, each party into a copy of its own (crates/server/src/play/spaces.rs enter_zone). An open arena in a space of its own (content/instances/goblinsDread.json says how: everything round its own origin, played only in a copy). You come in facing the training dummy, and five slimes hop about it (spawns); bots wander in it as moving targets on the other side (crates/engine/src/bots.rs), there while anyone is. Offline it is what ?test=yard opens (docs/testing.md), so the rules tests stand where they expect: change where you come in, the dummy or the slimes and they move with it. `door` is where its way out lets you out in the world. Heights (top) are above its origin.
name: The Yard
about: A yard of your own: the training dummy, slimes, and wandering bots on the other side to try your weapons and skills on.
